title: ClickHouse Cluster Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the ClickHouse Helm chart.

nameOverride.title: Name Override
nameOverride.description: Override the name of the chart.

fullnameOverride.title: Full Name Override
fullnameOverride.description: Override the full name of the chart.

version.title: ClickHouse Cluster Version
version.description: Engine Version of the ClickHouse cluster.

mode.title: Cluster Topology Mode
mode.description: Define the ClickHouse cluster topology mode. 'withZookeeper' coordinates ClickHouse via external ZooKeeper clusters referenced through serviceRef.

shards.title: Shard Count
shards.description: Number of shards in the ClickHouse cluster.

cpu.title: CPU Request
cpu.description: The amount of CPU requested for each ClickHouse instance, can be a number or string with units.

memory.title: Memory(Gi)
memory.description: The amount of memory requested for each ClickHouse instance, unit is Gi.

requests.title: CPU and Memory Requests
requests.description: Optional CPU and memory requests for the ClickHouse shard, overriding the default requests derived from cpu/memory.

cpu.title: Request CPU
cpu.description: CPU requests for the ClickHouse shard.

memory.title: Request Memory
memory.description: Memory requests for the ClickHouse shard.

storageClassName.title: Storage Class Name
storageClassName.description: Kubernetes storage class name to use for persistent volumes.

storage.title: Storage(Gi)
storage.description: Size of the persistent storage volume in Gi.

disableExporter.title: Disable Exporter
disableExporter.description: Whether to disable the metrics exporter for ClickHouse components.

tolerations.title: ClickHouse Tolerations
tolerations.description: List of tolerations for scheduling ClickHouse pods.

storageClassName.title: Keeper Storage Class Name
storageClassName.description: Kubernetes storage class name for keeper persistent volumes.

cpu.title: Keeper CPU Request
cpu.description: The amount of CPU requested for each ClickHouse Keeper instance, can be a number or string with units.

memory.title: Keeper Memory(Gi)
memory.description: The amount of memory requested for each ClickHouse Keeper instance, unit is Gi.

storage.title: Keeper Storage(Gi)
storage.description: Size of the keeper's persistent storage volume in Gi.

tolerations.title: Keeper Tolerations
tolerations.description: List of tolerations for scheduling ClickHouse Keeper pods.

zookeeper.title: External ZooKeeper Configuration
zookeeper.description: External ZooKeeper clusters referenced via serviceRef. Only rendered in the 'withZookeeper' mode. The primary ZooKeeper replaces ClickHouse Keeper as the default <zookeeper>; up to 7 auxiliary clusters are rendered into <auxiliary_zookeepers>.

primary.title: Primary ZooKeeper
primary.description: The primary ZooKeeper cluster reference. When set, it replaces ClickHouse Keeper.

namespace.title: ZooKeeper Cluster Namespace
namespace.description: Namespace of the referenced ZooKeeper cluster. Defaults to the ClickHouse cluster namespace when empty.

cluster.title: ZooKeeper Cluster Name
cluster.description: Name of the referenced ZooKeeper cluster.

component.title: ZooKeeper Component Name
component.description: Component name of the referenced ZooKeeper cluster.

auxiliary.title: Auxiliary ZooKeeper Clusters
auxiliary.description: List of auxiliary ZooKeeper clusters, up to 7. They are rendered into <auxiliary_zookeepers> and referenced by replicated tables/databases, e.g. ReplicatedMergeTree('zookeeper2:/path', 'replica').

namespace.title: Auxiliary ZooKeeper Namespace
namespace.description: Namespace of the referenced auxiliary ZooKeeper cluster. Defaults to the ClickHouse cluster namespace when empty.

cluster.title: Auxiliary ZooKeeper Cluster Name
cluster.description: Name of the referenced auxiliary ZooKeeper cluster.

component.title: Auxiliary ZooKeeper Component Name
component.description: Component name of the referenced auxiliary ZooKeeper cluster.

initClusterName.title: Init Cluster Name
initClusterName.description: Name of the cluster used for ON CLUSTER statements and remote_servers configuration.

type.title: Service Type
type.description: Type of service to expose ClickHouse. Valid options are 'ExternalName', 'ClusterIP', 'NodePort', and 'LoadBalancer'.

tls.title: TLS Configuration
tls.description: Settings for TLS configuration of the ClickHouse cluster.

enabled.title: TLS Enabled
enabled.description: Enable or disable TLS for the ClickHouse cluster.

issuer.title: TLS Issuer
issuer.description: Issuer type for TLS certificates. Options are 'KubeBlocks' or 'UserProvided'.

secretName.title: TLS Secret Name
secretName.description: Name of the secret containing the TLS certificate when using UserProvided issuer.

terminationPolicy.title: Termination Policy
terminationPolicy.description: Define Cluster termination policy. Options: DoNotTerminate, Delete, WipeOut.
